(Immune to Sense.) OR During your move phase, target opponent’s character at an interior Cloud City site. Draw destiny. Relocate target to Weather Vane if destiny > target’s ability. OR Relocate your character at an interior Cloud City site to Weather Vane. |errata_history=Versions of [[Slip Sliding Away (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026). * '''Original''' ([[Slip Sliding Away (V) (Virtual Set 6)]]): the “Final Revised Virtual Set 6” sheet “Virtual Set #6” (Players Committee; announced and tournament-legal 12 January 2004; PDF dated 12 January 2004), page 3, slip 44 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040619231451/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 19 June 2004; the Committee still hosts the same file as [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards6.pdf VirtualCards6.pdf] on res.starwarsccg.org), announced on the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040415220046/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news page]: “Cancels Path Of Least Resistance. S OR During your move phase, target opponent's character at an interior Cloud City site and draw destiny. If destiny > target's ability, move target to Weather Vane. OR Relocate your character at an interior Cloud City site to Weather Vane.” This is the earliest surviving slip: the first release sheet of 21 November 2003 is not preserved. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “6•44” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The updated sheet of 12 October 2004 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20050406053829/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%206.pdf Virtual Set 6.pdf], Internet Archive 6 April 2005; PDF dated 12 October 2004) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS6-44-Slip_Sliding_Away-original-slip-2004-10-12.png]]). * '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154341/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards6.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 44), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Cancel Path Of Least Resistance. (Immune to Sense.) OR During your move phase, target opponent’s character at an interior Cloud City site. Draw destiny. Relocate target to Weather Vane if destiny > target’s ability. OR Relocate your character at an interior Cloud City site to Weather Vane.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card. |printings='''Decipher''' — [[Slip Sliding Away]] (5_154)

Slip image and game text from this sheet. * Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Slip Sliding Away]]. * Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds#Cards|Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]] (fan reconstruction, 2026). * Earlier versions: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040619231451/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf final revised sheet of 12 January 2004] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20050406053829/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%206.pdf revised sheet of 12 October 2004] (old pre-Remaster slips). |hatnote=This is the current (Remaster) text of this Virtual Original card. For the earliest surviving (January 2004) slip, see [[Slip Sliding Away (V) (Virtual Set 6)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Slip Sliding Away]]. }} [[Category:Virtual Original sets]]
